title: Williams Contracts Spec Artifact
description: JSON Schema describing the repository-specific machine-readable contract-spec representation used by the committed snapshots in spec/ (e.g. will-v0.1.0.json, will-v1.3.0.json). This schema validates the artifact container format: a top-level object carrying contract metadata, a functions array, a types map, and an optional errors array.

$schema.description: Reference to the schema used to validate this artifact. Resolves to ./will-spec.schema.json relative to the snapshot file.

contract.description: Name of the contract described by this artifact.

crate_version.description: Version of the crate that produced this artifact.

generated_by.description: Tool or process that generated this artifact.

inputs.description: Ordered list of input parameter type strings.

types.description: Map from type name to the ordered list of its field strings.

errors.description: Optional list of contract error definitions.
